sense.text:
“The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be”: the thing spoken of is man on the earth. “And that which is done is that which shall be done”, whether man keeps the commandments or does not keep the commandments. “And there is no new thing under the sun.” From the time of Genesis, as it has been, so it is going to be in these last days.

This is the ground for everything else in the class: what we read in the scriptures is not only history. The things from the past are reoccurring events.

“Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.” There are no new incidents on this earth. The things that are done by man are the things that were done in the past.

“There is no remembrance of former things”, and the reason is that the spirits from the past return in the future. “Neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.”

precepts.why:
What is “the thing” of Ecclesiastes 1:9? Solomon answers it himself: “That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.”

So the thing that hath been and shall be again is man and what man does. The same kind of men, doing the same kind of things, come around again.

Paul says what Ecclesiastes 1:9 says, in different words with the same meaning: “For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning.” Written for our learning today, because the things done in the past reoccur in the future.

In the Christian mind that makes no sense, because everything seems new. But nothing is new; everything that was done in the past is reoccurring.

“That we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” So to deal with these reoccurring events we must read the history and the testimonies of our ancestors from the past.

The Lord says, “I will liken my judgment unto a ring.” A ring is a circle. He is comparing his judgments on the earth to a ring.

“Like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first.” Slackness means slow: there is no slackness of the last events and no swiftness of the first judgments. It is a continual event, one that reoccurs over and over and over. It is the same thing.

That is why Paul said to comfort yourselves through what is written in the testimonies of the past: what you are living is just a reoccurring event. The same idolatry of Babylon came around again in Greece, like a ring, and America is not absolved from it.

“I have also spoken by the prophets”: all the prophets spoke, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Daniel, Hosea even. “And I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.” Similitudes are parables, comparing one thing to another.

That is how the last beast of Revelation 13 is read: by comparing one thing to another. The last beast has all the attributes of the beasts before it.

sense.text:
“And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns.” The seven heads are Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany and Great Britain, and the eighth head is America. The ten horns are Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark and Ireland. These are all European powers, because that is what this is talking about.

“And upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.” Everything that comes from the Europeans is blasphemous to the word of God. Everything. What you think you can trust in, you cannot trust in.

This last beast has all the attributes of the beasts before it, and John describes it by the animal symbols of the four empires of Daniel 7.

“And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard”: Greece's symbol was the leopard, so this last kingdom has attributes of the ancient Grecian empire. “And his feet were as the feet of a bear”: Persia and Media's symbol was the bear, so this last empire, the dragon with seven heads and ten horns, has attributes of ancient Persia and Media. “And his mouth as the mouth of a lion”: ancient Babylon's symbol was the lion, so this last kingdom has attributes of ancient Babylon in it.

“And the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.” The dragon in this part is Satan. He gave him his power: his nuclear power, his armaments, his seat and great authority.

precepts.why:
How do we know it is Satan who gave the beast his power? Because you can be blessed by God or you can be blessed by Satan, and many people don't understand that. The devil “taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them; And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.”

That is the stipulation: “if thou wilt fall down and worship me.” I'll give you all this power and authority. It is the same thing read in Revelation 13:2, “the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.” The kingdoms of the world and their glory are Satan's to give, and he gives them to those who worship him.

People want to be blessed by Satan. On Venice Beach there are women in their fifties and sixties who have been there since their twenties waiting to be discovered, ran through by every so-called movie or music producer that walks up and down that beach, twenty, thirty, forty men, and still waiting. A man about ninety years old playing the guitar, waiting to be seen by Rolling Stone magazine. People are delusional.

Many of our people want what Satan offers. “But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition. For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.”

That is what Satan will have you do: pierce yourself through with many sorrows, because you covet to be rich in this world. If you covet fame and fortune, you must worship Satan. You must. That is the only way. That is what the Bible is saying, and it is the same bargain the dragon made with the beast.

sense.text:
Remember that this last empire, the dragon with seven heads and ten horns, has attributes like a lion, which was ancient Babylon. So Daniel 3 shows what Babylon does, and what the last empire will do.

“Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold”, set it up in the plain of Dura, and gathered “the princes, the governors, and the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces” to “the dedication of the image”, and “they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.”

You may read that and say that was back then and doesn't happen today. But this week pastors prayed over a massive gold statue of Donald Trump in Florida. MAGA evangelical leaders gathered at Mar-a-Lago and at Trump National Doral in Miami to bless and dedicate a 22-foot gold-leaf statue, dubbed Don Colossus, with his fist raised as he raised it after the July 2024 assassination attempt in Butler, Pennsylvania. The dedication was led by the evangelical pastor Mark Burns, who said it was not a golden calf but a symbol of resilience, freedom and patriotism. The leaders prayed over the monument while the supporters applauded around its base, and Trump called in by phone to thank them. That is the comparison with Daniel 3: they prayed over a 22-foot golden image of a man.

Listen to what this Edomite says: he called it insanity, and named the long history of white Christians enslaving black men, women and children and lynching black folks after church in the name of Jesus. The black Christians will hear the white man say what we have been saying for decades and turn a deaf ear to it.

“And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.”

Remember what was read: the thing that hath been is that which shall be, and there is no new thing under the sun, and the things written aforetime were written for our learning. The things from the past are reoccurring events, so what we read in Daniel 3 we see coming to pass with the Trump administration: the setting up of the golden statue.

Some of you have been swooned to sleep, thinking nothing is ever going to happen here. Now you see a big gold statue set up, and you say, he didn't make nobody pray to it yet.

At the sound of the music “all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshipped the golden image”, and certain Chaldeans accused the Jews, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego: “they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.”

Nebuchadnezzar had set up a one world religion. That is what he did, and it is the same thing they are trying to do today.
“We are not careful to answer thee in this matter”: meaning, we are not worried to answer you.

“Our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king. But if not”: they understood that God does what he wants. You cannot force the Lord to save you. You cannot force him to deliver you. If God chooses not to save us, “be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.”

They understood that the body is temporal, temporary. The body will go, but the spirit lives on.

“Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.”

How did Nebuchadnezzar know that was a son of God? He didn't; many translations say the fourth one looks like a god. The translators understood it was Christ.

The fire had no power on their bodies, “nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.” And Nebuchadnezzar blessed the God “who hath sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king's word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.”

These are the things we have to read and learn and implement within our own hearts and minds and souls, because these events will occur again.

Nebuchadnezzar decreed that whoever spoke amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach and Abed-nego should be cut in pieces, “because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort”, and promoted them in Babylon.

But when you read the history, Nebuchadnezzar did not hold true to that at all. He went crazy, and he went back to his idolatrous ways again.

precepts.why:
Back in Revelation 13, the beast “opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.” This is the white man as Rome, the Roman Catholic Church, the mother of all the Christian denominations, blaspheming the name of the Lord.

“And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them.” The twelve tribes of Israel are the saints. The white man orchestrated war against us under Pope Nicholas, and he overcame us and enslaved us. Pastor Burns doesn't have a clue what is going on: these people made war against us and enslaved us. “And power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations”: that is how the white race became the dominant race on the planet.

“And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him.” Everybody on this earth worships the white man as God, as Jesus, as the angels, as the Jews. Ask a Muslim who that image is, and he says Jesus; a Buddhist will say the same. No matter what religion, they all acknowledge the white man as God and Christ. That is some of your mothers and fathers, sisters and brothers, and some of your children.

Even the world's own shows put it on display. In The Boys, the Superman-like Homelander, blonde-haired like Trump, with the evangelical Christians mixed into the politics, declares that an angel told him his destiny: not serving the Lord, but being the Lord, the Messiah, the saviour of the world. He sets himself up as God on the planet, and the other heroes are afraid of him because he has more power than all of them. That is the image of Daniel 3 set up again, and the whole earth bowing to it.

The Babylonian captivity was not the only time. In the Greek captivity, “king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people, And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king. Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed unto idols, and profaned the sabbath.” Many of the Israelites consented, like Pastor Mark Burns.

The king sent letters that they should “follow the strange laws of the land”, profane the sabbaths and festival days, “Set up altars, and groves, and chapels of idols, and sacrifice swine's flesh”, leave their children uncircumcised, “To the end they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances.” That was the purpose of setting up these things: that we would forget God's law.

“And whosoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die”, the same as the fiery furnace for whoever would not fall down. The same idolatry read in Babylon is the same idolatry that happened in Greece. It is like a ring, and it is going to continue. Don't think America is absolved from this; we are seeing elements of it now.

sense.text: “For the devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication”: idolatry was the beginning of sin. You may say, didn't Eve eat an apple? It wasn't an apple. It was idolatry. “And the invention of them the corruption of life.”

“For neither were they from the beginning, neither shall they be for ever.” When the Lord created Adam and Eve there was no idolatry; that came some time later. And they shall not be forever, because there comes an end.

Solomon gives an example of how idolatry grows in the earth. A mighty man, a king, whose son had an untimely death, “made an image of his child soon taken away, now honoured him as a god, which was then a dead man, and delivered to those that were under him ceremonies and sacrifices.” He created ceremonies and sacrifices in honour of his child, like the honour given to Tammuz.

“Thus in process of time an ungodly custom grown strong was kept as a law.” It took time for it to grow strong, and now it is kept as law: like December 25th, worshipping Cesare Borgia as Jesus. That is a ceremony, a custom, and it has grown strong in the earth. “And graven images were worshipped by the commandments of kings”: kings commanded the people to worship those idols. That is what Christmas is about; that is what resurrection Sunday, Easter Sunday, is all about.

And here is the lie, especially among women: I don't do it because America says to, I do it for the children. Then why on that particular day? Women are more prone to idolatry than men. That is what Adam and Eve is about: Satan went to Eve, not Adam. He couldn't get through to him, but he could get through to her, and sure enough she brought the idolatry she learned to her husband. Some of you go through that in your house right now.

“Whom men could not honour in presence, because they dwelt far off, they took the counterfeit of his visage from far, and made an express image of a king whom they honoured, to the end that by this their forwardness they might flatter him that was absent, as if he were present.”

His visage is his image. They took his image across the world: the white man took the counterfeit of this white man's image from far, from Rome and Spain, under the names of the conquistadors. Columbus came with a whole wooden cross and images of Jesus, and thousands of conquistadors went worldwide with them.

“Also the singular diligence of the artificer did help to set forward the ignorant to more superstition.” The artificer is the artist. Our people in Christianity truly believe those false images of the white man are Jesus or God, and the Bible calls them the ignorant.

“For he, peradventure willing to please one in authority, forced all his skill to make the resemblance of the best fashion.” Leonardo da Vinci's sketches in the 1400s were preliminary sketches of Cesare Borgia as the new Jesus.

The Sallman head is another example. The Head of Christ is a 1940 portrait of Jesus by Warner Sallman. It was marketed by the publishing arm of the Church of God; the Baptist bookstores popularized it, selling lithographs throughout the southern United States; and the Salvation Army and the YMCA, as members of the USO, handed out pocket-sized versions to American servicemen heading overseas in World War II. They redid what Leonardo did, and that is how it became so famous.

“And so the multitude, allured by the grace of the work, took him now for a god, which a little before was but honoured.” They said, that's the son of God, when a little before he was honoured as a man: Cesare Borgia. It can be said of Nimrod too; it starts with Nimrod, Semiramis and Tammuz, names many of our people do not know.

“And this was an occasion to deceive the world”: idolatry was an occasion to deceive the world. Men serving either calamity or tyranny “did ascribe unto stones and stocks the incommunicable name.” Stocks means wood. They said, let's call it God.

“That they erred in the knowledge of God”: we know God is not his name, it is a title, but that is the title they put on those images. “But whereas they lived in the great war of ignorance”: remember verse 18 called the people the ignorant.

We tell people those images are not God and they are not to worship them, and they say it is okay to worship them. “Those so great plagues called they peace.” They call it peace. When we teach, Thou shalt have no other gods before the Most High, they say we are disturbing them and causing division. In Liberia, on every radio show, they asked why we are causing division. Because that white image you are worshipping is the devil.

“For whilst they slew their children in sacrifices, or used secret ceremonies, or made revellings of strange rites; They kept neither lives nor marriages any longer undefiled”. You read that and say that only happened in the past. Now with the Epstein files coming out we understand verse 23 better: the name of Epstein's bank account, Baal, the demon that demanded human sacrifice; torture videos; a ranch where girls not of age were used; presidents and princes named in ritual abuse. Your president's name is all in those files, and Hillary's. God is exposing these wicked people to shatter the idols people have made of popular figures.

“Changing of kind” is the changing of gender, males becoming females and females becoming males.

“Disorder in marriages” in these last days. That is why marriage events are held, to help brothers and sisters get strong in their marriages. When you deal with idolatry, hatred, malice, grudging and bitterness, your marriage gets corrupted one way or the other.

“For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.” Is the beginning: the beginning sin, with Eve, was idolatry. And the end: these end times are going to end the same way. Idolatry.

precepts.why:
Verse 17 goes with Christ's warning: “Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.”

In Liberia, ten men out teaching were told that the many Christ spoke of was them, those ten men. That is foolish. Go back to Wisdom 14:17: they “took the counterfeit of his visage from far”, from Rome, and “made an express image of a king whom they honoured.” Columbus came with the cross and images of Jesus, and thousands of conquistadors went worldwide. He isn't talking about ten black men with a Bible; he is talking about these folks.

But our people in Africa don't want to admit that. They feel better, or safer, saying it is us than saying it is the white man.

Disorder in marriages: a sister sent in a question for the marriage event asking how to take counsel from leadership when one leader was put out for adultery. That is not beneficial to marriage; it is an attack, it is hateful. There are three bishops and seven or eight deacons, and she ignores all the others and highlights the one.

Brothers, be mindful who you marry. A woman like that will make your life miserable; she will record everything she disagrees with you about and come back with a book. One sister in counsel handed over a whole notebook going back five years with dates and times, and it was flung across the room. These are idolatrous women, some of them idolatrous evil black women, and they will try to destroy your life. She has two problems for every solution.

This is what you look for: “She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.” That is the kind of wife you want. There was no kindness or wisdom in that email. That is not wife material.

When Israel is in the midst of sin, God speaks of her in the female context: “She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her”. It is a word that is hurtful, so God says it.

Scum is a layer of foul or unwanted matter that forms on top of a liquid, like pond scum or soap scum; it refers to a despised, immoral or worthless person, the scum of the earth. In the slang it is the epitome of a worthless, good-for-nothing human, the bottom of the hierarchy of humans, possibly the worst word you can have your name associated with: someone so disgraceful they are seen as the lowest form of life, a waste of skin, dirt, nothing. Because it is perfectly acceptable English it is even more demeaning than profanity; it is the only word for the job, and it makes the victim feel like the lowest of the low.

God says the scum is still there. Some of these evil sisters are the scum of the earth. That is what God is saying.

sense.text:
We go through prophecies and see what is going to happen. We have the blueprint of what is going to go down: you just saw Daniel 3 coming to life in our time, history repeating itself, and what the Lord says will happen to Babylon is that it is going to burn. But what good does it do us if we are not preparing for all the bad that is coming?

“A prudent man foreseeth the evil”: we have leadership able to show us the things that are going to come to pass. If you are smart, you'll get ready. “And hideth himself”: he sees what is about to happen and prepares for it.

“But the simple pass on, and are punished.” Somebody watching this class is taking notes, saying that's some good stuff, and then will close the Bible, go home, and proceed to be a demon. You have seen the evil, but you are not hiding.

precepts.why:
Knowing the time, we had better prepare ourselves. “For the world is divided into twelve parts, and the ten parts of it are gone already, and half of a tenth part: And there remaineth that which is after the half of the tenth part.” That was in the time of Ezra. We are in the last days. The clock is ticking.

“Now therefore set thine house in order”: knowing the time, brothers and sisters, we must set our houses in order. “And reprove thy people”: notice we start first with setting our own houses in order, and then we have the ability to go and tell somebody else to get right. “Comfort such of them as be in trouble, and now renounce corruption.”

If we are going to set our houses in order, where do we start? With our marriages. If the home front isn't right, how are you going to instruct your people, and how are we going to inherit what the Lord has prepared for us?

Bound and bondage are two different things. Bound is placed under legal or moral restraint or obligation: marriage is a legal obligation through the Most High God, a covenant between you two that is honoured by the Lord. Bondage is a state of being bound by compulsion, such as slavery or serfdom. Some perceive marriage as slavery: when wives hear the word submit, the first thing they think is, I'm a servant, I'm a slave. That is not what it is. It is order, what the Lord designed as marriage.

sense.text:
Back to the beginning, to why marriage was made: “It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.”

Brothers, who gives you your wife? The Lord does, right? Are you sure?

precepts.why:
“Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun”. Who gave her to you? The Lord did. Believe it or not, that sister was created for you.

“For that is thy portion in this life.” This is your portion that you have all the days of the life of your vanity. Some of you say, God did that, but she's all jacked up.

Here is another surprise, brother: “A wicked woman is given as a portion to a wicked man: but a godly woman is given to him that feareth the Lord.” The Bible says it; nobody here wrote it.

So ask yourself why she is jacked up: because you are jacked up. Brothers see all of her flaws, all her issues, every problem she has, and look at themselves like they never did anything wrong. Ask yourself, why was she given to me? What am I doing, or not reflecting on, or not being real with myself about, that I am in this situation?

“A good wife is a good portion, which shall be given in the portion of them that fear the Lord.” A good wife is given to the man who deserves a good wife.

If you are not serious about this walk in his truth, how can you expect a righteous woman? Everybody says, I want that virtuous woman, but you're nasty. You have been committing adultery since you came into the truth, and you want the Proverbs 31 woman. No, sir. You get the scum, the bottom of the barrel, because of where your faith is.

But it is not always the case, as sisters say, if I messed up that means you messed up. Sometimes a husband is trying to get you right, trying to correct you, trying to show you what he wants so you can be who he wants you to be.

A reality check for the evil sisters who think, if I'm evil, he's evil, and we'll just be evil together: “And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her”.

A man will be delivered from a woman like that. He will escape; he will get away. Sisters, don't think you can be evil and die that way and be together forever. The Lord will deliver him. Repent and get your things together so you can be heirs together.

Write this down: marriage is a covenant. “The Lord hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth.” The wife of thy youth: marriage was designed for you to marry young. You can marry when you are older, but naturally, when a young boy becomes a man and a young woman becomes a woman, that is when they search for a companion, to have children and to grow old together.

“Against whom thou hast dealt treacherously”: brothers who deal treacherously with your wives, the Lord sees you, you are not getting away with it, and there is payment for that. “Yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.”

A brother married a sister who told him before they married that she was schizophrenic and on medication. Later he came to the Bishop saying he had to get rid of her because she was crazy, running up on sisters who only said shalom to him. The answer was: you knew, so she is yours. She is the wife of your covenant. Don't be fooled by beauty.

“Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.” Rejoice with the wife you married when you were young. Some here have been married thirty years and more; the Bishop has been married thirty-six years. Those who have been married a long time are supposed to still look at their wife or husband and see when they were young. You both change and you both get old, but you remember, and that is why you can be content.

“Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.” This is why it is designed from your youth: it is something you have grown into together that nobody on the planet can understand. You walk in the room and she is the only thing you see. That is a bond that can't be broken if you are in the Lord.

As the Bishop put it with a clock: when you marry your wife young, her breasts are at three o'clock; as you grow old together they will be at six o'clock. But they are yours, brother, no matter what time it is.

“And now, O Lord, I take not this my sister for lust but uprightly: therefore mercifully ordain that we may become aged together.”

We pray that we see our older years together. Some make it there and some don't. If you don't, let it be because of passing, not because you are not applying the scriptures and not listening in class. The prophetic classes are dope, but you have to pay attention to these classes about marriage and repentance with the same zeal and apply them in your everyday life. Otherwise your marriage is going to fall apart, your kids will go who knows where, and then you will look at the leadership like it was their fault.

sense.text:
“For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife”. A man leaves his father and mother's house to be joined to his wife. The reason he leaves is to start his own family, not to go out there and figure it out. You don't send your son out like that, and the same with our daughters: you don't send your daughters out into the world to figure it out, where she has no protection.

“And they two shall be one flesh.”

“This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.” Marriage is a mystery for some, but in this truth we understand what it represents. The marriage is a mirror image of Christ and the church: the husband represents Christ, and the wife represents the church.

“Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it”. Did Christ give his life for the church? Would you give your life for your wife, for your house, to understanding how to deal with your wife the right way?

When we really understand that we are the representation of Christ in the home, we move like Christ in the house. You speak it and you walk it. We are not hypocritical in our speech; we do thus saith the Lord, because that is what we require of them.

“That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word”. Did Christ deal harshly with the church at times? He did.

Many sisters have the misconception that the man is supposed to be soft-spoken and receivable at all times, and that everything that comes out of his mouth should make sense to you. You might agree with your husband maybe thirty percent of the time; the majority of the time you will be doing things you don't agree with. It is not for you to agree. It is for you to do.

The first thing wives say about submission is, as unto the Lord: you ain't Christ; Jesus wouldn't say what you're saying. Really? But Christ did deal sharply with those he loved.

precepts.why:
“Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee. But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me”.

Sisters call and say, my husband said I got the devil on me. Well, did you? No one wants to admit being rightfully called something, whether it is demonic, rebellious or the devil. Peter was called Satan himself, and there is nothing worse than being called Satan.

It is not okay to call your wife out of her name. But there are times you need to realize you are being the devil, and Christ said so: I see the spirit on you, and I'm going to tell you what it is.

There arose a great storm and the ship was full, and they woke him: “Master, carest thou not that we perish?” Don't you care? We are going to die in the sea. “And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm. And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?”

Sisters have heard that from their husband and were the most offended: you tell your wife her faith is weak, and what's wrong with you? No, it's the truth. Christ said it to strengthen them, to get them to realize, you are moving in fear. Why are you acting scared? Don't you believe?

Depending on who is reading, you can hear the frustration in Christ's voice: “O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.” Christ got frustrated, Christ got angry, Christ was fed up, and Christ called them names: faithless and perverse. Did that mean he didn't love them? No. He dealt that way because it was necessary.

How many times have you told your wife that what she was doing was wrong, and heard, why are you so mean? Why can't she receive it the way they received it from Christ? Many times you will find your wife doesn't see Christ in you, brother, and that is why everything is taken offensively.

Sisters, some brothers are crazy and are tearing down, not building up. But it is not for you to decide; you have to put it all in the Lord's hands.

“To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven”. Christ drove men out of the temples and called for destruction on cities. Just because his demeanour was such doesn't mean he didn't love the church. “A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up”.

Sisters, you have to trust that the Lord is dealing with your husband and that he understands those times. It is not always going to be beautiful or romantic, but he does love you, and he is telling you this for the betterment of you and the household.

“A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.” The Lord has given man the ability to discern between those times, and it is his job to do it. If you won't allow him to, and take everything as, he's trying to destroy me, you will never be built up. Trust that the one the Lord created you for is going to take care of you.

sense.text: Write this down: the divine order. “For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.”

“Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.” Why does that follow immediately after God is not the author of confusion? Because a woman speaking out of turn in the church is confusion. A woman not in order is confusion.

Whenever you have issues in your household, it is because you allowed confusion to breach. You allowed feminism into the house and didn't stop it at the door. You allowed pride to come in and didn't stop it at the door.

precepts.why:
There is history behind why Paul said, Let the women keep silence in the churches. While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul came to Ephesus, and that whole region was worshipping a goddess: “the temple of the great goddess Diana”, “whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.” When they knew that he was a Jew, “all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.”

That worship of the goddess Diana went through that whole region. Some of those women so-called repented and came into the church still feeling that, as women, they should speak: that is the whole feminist movement. The same spirit is back today. That is why you have to whisper in your own house.

Sisters don't want to admit that is the spirit they are rolling in. Feminism has been normalized, and it should not be named among us. If you are scared of your wife, brother, take the purple shirt off. You cannot go out and cast down the lies of the nations and bring us out of this captivity if you are scared to deal with your wife at home.

sense.text:
“But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man”. Brothers and sisters have been through this before, and nobody is confused on the order. Then why are there so many problems in Israel, and so much confusion about what we call gender roles, your position as a husband and your position as a wife? Because pride has made its way in, confusion has set itself in your house, and folks don't know what to do.

Because of your lack of leadership, brother, because you are non-confrontational and passive and don't want any smoke, she raises her voice and you cower. She walks by shoulder-bumping you, and you can't raise your voice in your own house. All because you gave up your position.

“And the head of Christ is God.” Was Christ ever confused at any moment in his life about his position and role with the Father?

precepts.why:
“I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.” Christ said, I am doing exactly as the Father told me to do. He is not doing what he wants.

Christ understands his role and position, and Christ tells us the husband is the head of the wife. So why is there still so much confusion? Somebody doesn't believe like they say they do.

The biggest issue in Israel is us not understanding our place. Typically it is the side of the room fighting against order, but it happens with the brothers too: some of you want to be mama's boys in the house. You didn't want a wife; you wanted a mom.

“I will make him an help meet for him.” Define help: an assistance, an aid; to give assistance or support to someone, to provide someone with something useful or necessary in achieving an end. Meet means suitable for him.

We don't really understand what the help is supposed to do, because sometimes the help thinks she is supposed to lead or guide. A help is someone who assists in making happen what the husband wants. That is what the help does.

“Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.” It was not only at this point that the woman was supposed to listen to the husband: she was already made to assist him, back in Genesis 2.

So why today do we feel a help is a bad thing? Sisters, the help is the greatest thing you are ever going to be. The moment you decide being a help is not the greatest thing you can be, or that you are supposed to be something outside of the help, you will destroy your marriage. And brothers, the moment you decide not to provide, not to be the man God told you to be, your marriage will crumble. It is a domino effect.

Leading is maintenance, a routine thing a husband has to do. Your wife is never going to say she is trying to overthrow you, but it is in her spirit, and you will constantly have to remind her: I am the head; you have to listen to me. It is understandable, just as when you get orders from those over you and want to do it your way; she has the same thing in her. But that doesn't mean it can't be dealt with.

Write this down: women were never designed to lead men. In law enforcement, running into a crime scene, a female partner had to turn back because her period had just come; or she is pregnant and out for nine or ten months. And she is supposed to lead you into danger?

“As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err”. Women ruling over you is a curse, brothers. This is not good; it shows things are out of order.

Some of you are scared to lead your house and have let her lead. Look at your demeanour and how other men look at you; everyone knows. If you are passive and afraid of confrontation, she is going to walk all over you. Stand up, brother. Take your balls back.

God did not set it up like that. Women were designed to be a help to their husbands, and when they step outside of that and you allow it, chaos ensues. That is why there is dysfunction in our nation: because you don't want to lead.

“How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the Lord hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.” This was never heard of, women being over men. It is not natural; it is not the natural state of a man to be run by a woman, but you allow it.

Your wife pays all the bills while you are on the couch playing video games, and you don't know why there is trouble in your home. It is because your wife is running things. She looks at it as normal because she has been the breadwinner from day one, and you are used to it. You want a mama, not a wife.

“And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men”. The Lord uses men to lead. It has always been that way, and it is never going to change. You are not going to change the order of things just because you are weak and scared of your wife.

Sisters, the beta men on social media making you think the man is supposed to worship the ground you walk on are not going to influence the men in purple and gold. We don't care about being called narcissist or misogynist. You are going to follow, or you can go find one of them. Do you want a man or a boy?

Sisters say, you get around the brothers and come home acting different. He is supposed to come home different. He is supposed to be on fire to take back what is his; he sees where he is lacking, examines himself, and says, I need to fix my house. The same way, after he has been rebuked for adultery or for not dealing with his wife the right way, he is supposed to move different, if he truly believes.

There is an attack to destroy the household. Satan and his people know that to destroy us they have to attack our foundation, and the foundation is the home. We are building a nation, and if we are not strong on the home front we are not going to get off the ground.

“In the last days perilous times shall come. For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud”, all the way to “lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God”. All these are types of people released and sent out to destroy. “Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.” These are your social media influencers, the beta men bigging our women's heads up, making them think they are greater, smarter and stronger than us.

“For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts”. They creep into houses and get into your infrastructure, through the phone, through conversation, through a cousin, through whoever is influencing her.

Sisters deep in social media with men in their DMs: there is no man in your DMs who wants to marry you. Men don't think like that. They want to sleep with you; there is a difference. You are not going to find better than the man God put together with you, and once you leave, the protection of God is no longer on you. A married sister with three children and a husband, retired military, who took care of her, was twerking on TikTok for thirty dollars from recording artists and refused to stop. If your wife is twerking for thirty dollars, brother, she is not your wife.

It is very difficult to argue constantly with your boss; you understand your opinion isn't always asked for or needed. Why don't you understand it is the same, if not more, with your husband? It should be as difficult for you to argue with the head of the house as with Christ himself.

The first thing sisters say is, but he's evil though; I can't submit to a man like that. “Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives”. If any obey not the word: he isn't even in the truth, he is breaking all the laws. And still the wives are told that through their chaste conversation, their obedience and their example they can win him over. So you still have to listen to him, even if he is wrong.

Ask yourself: do you believe you serve a God who will redeem you and save you from a wicked man, or one who will leave you to die? Do you serve a God who will have mercy on you because you are faithful? That is the real question. Do you believe?

sense.text:
This is the same Joshua who came out of Egypt, who saw all the wickedness of Israel. “Choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.”

A man of the Lord understands his first role: he must command his house. He guides his house, and those in his house don't have a choice. Some of you have kids who aren't keeping the commandments, and you let them do whatever; you wonder why there is confusion in the home, one child coming against another. As for you and your house, what are you going to do?

Your first role is commander in chief of the house, and you have to see yourself that way, or you will allow someone else to have rule in your home. Each man leads his own house: not, the deacon said, or that's how they do it at the deacon's house. This is your house. You must command your home.

precepts.why:
“But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.” Your role as a husband is to provide. You are the provider.

Many of our households today are only sustained because there are two incomes. It is extremely difficult for a man to hold down everything now, but it is possible, and you have to be able to if you must. If it is a mean cottage, then it is a mean cottage, but it is yours. Even if she works, don't let that take any rule in your home; the income is the household income. Don't be a tyrant: things may have to adjust. But brothers, if you give up your position, you will never get it back.

It is an attack on the Israelite household. Edomite, Moabite and other women work just as well, but the idea that because I make money I get a say in this household is pushed on no community but the black and Hispanic community. God never said to split the power because of the money you make; that is written nowhere in the Bible. His flock is the man; you are the leader at all times, and sisters are the helpmeets. They are trying to destroy us so that we never rise back up as a nation.

One president's wife went on national TV and disgraced her husband: Michelle Obama, the only black one. Because she made money as a lawyer, she felt she was over him. It is so humiliating for black people.

“Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.” We have been commanded to love our wives. You have to have restraint regardless of the things that have happened. You have to be Christ in the home; that is your God-given position. So you have to be able to forgive, to let go, and to have the emotional stability within yourself to lead the home properly. Love your wife as a commandment.

“Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.” What did Christ do to make sure of that? He corrected them when things were out of line, he taught them, fed them, clothed them, and he died for the church.

That is the love you have to show your wife. If you are going to give your life, you will get up and investigate that strange sound downstairs instead of sending your wife. You will work the 32-hour shift to make sure the bills are paid, the lights stay on and there is food on the table. Some of you love the PlayStation more; that is your wife. If we find out that is you, your rank is stripped, plain clothes. If you lose the home, or there is no food on the table, we are looking at you. Your children can't be in busted clothes, hungry, while you have Jordans and the latest games.

“So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church”. That is how much you are supposed to love your wife: like she is you, because the two are one. There is no reason to treat your wife in a way you wouldn't want to be dealt with.

Every man here has an officer, captain, deacon or bishop over him who has dealt harshly with him when it was necessary. Sometimes you have to rebuke sharply. But you have to know how to do it. Some brothers know how to tear down but not how to build up, and then wonder why she walks around looking like depression on earth and never smiles. Tearing down is easy; building up is a skill. Just as you want to be built up, do it for her.

These are the attributes of a good man: “Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.” “He is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous. A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.” “He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the Lord.”

This man lends; he is there for his brother. He is not afraid of evil tidings or of confrontation. He understands what the Lord has put in front of him, and he deals with it. This is what we must possess as men of the Lord.

Write these down, so that the next time she asks, what do you do?, you have a response. “Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded. In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity, Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.”

These are the examples we must follow: how men are to conduct themselves, not only with one another but with their wives.

“If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.” That should be every man, because a bishop is an example of what we are all supposed to be. “A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach” and so on.

“One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity”. A bishop has to rule his house just like you. “For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?” If your own house is out of order and dysfunctional, if your wife and kids don't listen to you, how could you be an officer of anything? You cannot rule over men if you can't rule your own house.

Things husbands do that destroy marriages: first, adultery and fornication, which has ripped houses apart in Israel beyond repair. Some women will never let it go, even after you have asked the Lord for forgiveness. If you are on the fence, get help right now. Second, failure to lead: if you are passive and she walks all over you, eventually another man will catch her eye.

“Where no hedge is, there the possession is spoiled”. The flock of the Lord's pasture are men; the leaders are men. If you don't lead your house you lose control, and your possession, your wife, is spoiled. If you are not there guiding, instructing and correcting, the marriage will come to a crashing halt with her standing over you.

The rest of what destroys a marriage: bitterness and harshness, holding on to what she did after she repented, unrealistic expectations, insulting and humiliating her, which only makes you look a certain way; you are supposed to love your wife as yourself. Neglect: if a trip to Walmart is an exciting event for your wife, you have not taken her out. A man with a wife has the cares of the world, and there is maintenance. Pride and refusing correction: asking leadership for counsel, then remixing it and saying the deacon said that. Don't hand over the Rubik's cube after you have mixed it up. Financial irresponsibility: gambling, refusing to work, hiding spending, chasing image over stability. Lack of self-control: punching walls and saying what can't be unsaid. Loving the world, your job, status and friends more than your family. And withholding love and affection from your wife.

“Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel”. A wise husband studies his wife: her fears, her emotions, her struggles and her strengths. When you understand your wife, you can guide your house. You push her to greatness, but you also know her limits, and because you know them you set things up so that they work. If she isn't able to deal with certain things, you arrange it another way. It is the same with your kids.

Some men never learn their wives, and then wonder why the marriage feels distant.

sense.text: “Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.” It is no secret what submission means: you have to listen to your husband like he is Christ.

“Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.” In everything. You are the help: you assist your husband in what he wants.

It is the house of Abiel, not the house of Abiel and his wife, because the head is the husband. So it is his desires for what the house is supposed to be. If he wants a sound home, give him a sound home; a clean house, give him a clean house. The confusion comes when you feel your aspirations should supersede his. We are on the same team, yes, but he is the CEO of the team, making decisions for the franchise, not a player arguing the direction with him.

Most husbands are not tripping over the drapes, the pots and the forks. As long as he comes home to a clean house and good food, he doesn't care how it got done. Most of you exaggerate, making submission seem like straight slavery.

Things a wife does that destroy her marriage: disrespecting her husband, belittling him, talking down to him, embarrassing him publicly and constantly challenging his authority; the moment you tell him no, you have stepped out from under the rule God put over you. Contention and constant arguments: a submissive woman doesn't go back and forth; when that is happening, Satan is afoot. Refusing submission: competing with him and trying to dominate the household; two heads create confusion every time, and the Lord has always been about order. Public humiliation: gossiping about him and exposing private matters. Withholding intimacy as a weapon, which invites fornication to creep in. And following worldly counsel: evil mothers, aunts and friends, and a social media algorithm that feeds you that men aren't worth anything.

When sisters write in to shame their husbands, call him slothful, or tell him how to be a father, know there are things your husband will not receive from you. Push him to be around leadership, where the hot seat changes lives. Influence him by your actions: take the kids to the park yourself, and he will follow. Men don't respond to nagging. And brothers whose wife hasn't cooked in ten years: command your house.

precepts.why:
“As the sun when it ariseth in the high heaven; so is the beauty of a good wife in the ordering of her house.” The way she sets it up and does things is hers; keep him happy and he is good. If she wants to lift the carpet and vacuum the cushion underneath, she can, if that is what she needs to do.

Brothers whose wives are nasty and only clean when company is coming over: you have to order your house and demand it. Tell her, this is not the desire of my home. Brothers whose wives are neat freaks: that is a blessing, though sometimes you have to tell her to chill out.

Isn't this what sisters aspire to be? “Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies. The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.” He is confident in her because he has watched her and observed how she is, and he has no worries. Brothers, don't you want that? Sisters, don't you want to give that to your husband?

“She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.” A married brother was asked: a man on your wife's job grabs her hand and tries to talk to her, and she tells you she didn't say anything. He said he would go down to the job and talk to the man. That is the mistake. She will do him good: she is supposed to handle that herself, snatch her hand away and tell him, I'm married. When one captain called on his way to his wife's job to fight a man over the same thing, the Bishop told him to turn his car around, call his wife, and tell her she had better handle it, because that is her job. (If she is being forced, as in a rape, of course you do what you have to do.)

“She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household”: she is up before everybody preparing for her household; she has ordered her house. “She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard”: she is investing, all for the household. “She reacheth forth her hands to the needy”: she takes care of her people. “She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet”: she is prepared. “Her husband is known in the gates”: that is the type of man she has.

“She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness. She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.” Her household is her business, and she is not idle; she is working to take care of her and hers. That is a Proverbs 31 woman.

“Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.” Who has to institute that in the house? The husband. The children don't walk by in the morning without saluting their father and mother and saying good morning.

“The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things; That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children, To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.”

Keepers at home is what Sirach 26:16 called the beauty of a good wife in the ordering of her house. She takes care of her house: she gets up, feeds her family, keeps the house clean. She is not idle, because there are enough things in her own house to deal with; she is not out being a busybody in everybody else's house.

First it says to love their husbands, then to be obedient to their own husbands, “that the word of God be not blasphemed.” The word of God is blasphemed when a wife who claims she believes is not obedient to her husband, because the commandment says she must obey him.

“But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.” A man who doesn't take care of his house, doesn't provide for his wife and family, is like a man not even in the truth, not in the faith.

So what is the difference with a woman who does not submit to her husband? If he doesn't provide or doesn't love his wife as commanded, he has denied the faith; and if she doesn't submit, she is not a believer. You can tell if a woman believes the Bible by how she deals with her husband. If she believes, she will submit and reverence him; she will treat him as she would treat Christ, in her tone and in how she deals with him, not going back and forth.

“I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully. For some are already turned aside after Satan.”

Why was Paul telling the younger women to marry? The younger women wanted help from the church, so he told them they need husbands so they can be taken care of by their husbands. It happens among us too: women think the men are supposed to fund their lives. A woman who loses her husband young, tragic as it is, is expected to move on and marry; the congregation is not going to pay her bills into her old age. The older widows, who will not marry again, are the ones helped, “If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them”, and they are active widows, working for the truth.

sense.text:
“Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female, And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?” It is a short passage, but there is a lot packed into being one flesh.

We have constantly pushed the importance of applying the scriptures and what we learn to our everyday lives and our marriages. If we don't apply what we learn, we will not grow, our marriages will not improve, and we won't see any change in our homes. Even with the problems here, we are eons ahead of so many congregations and churches, but we are still trying to perfect it and get it right.

precepts.why:
“Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it”. We labour in vain if we are not building in the Lord. If we are not doing it according to how he said, it is going to crash; it is going to fall.

“Except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.” If the Lord is not protecting it, if the Lord is not behind it, we are labouring for no reason. All the tears, all the pain, all the grief you are going through will keep happening if you don't apply what you learn.

“Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering”. We have to put all these things on. If we are going to fix this, we have to step fully into what the Lord prescribed, because it gets rid of a lot of the nonsense we deal with.

“Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another”. Too many marriages suffer because one spouse doesn't want to forgive the other. If you keep holding the past over their head, you will never come out of it; you have to forgive and move past it, and allow the other person to grow into what you want them to be. “Even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.”

“And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness. And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.” Just as in the household you are one flesh. We must do what the Most High God told us to do and apply all that we have learned, so that our marriages can flourish.
